**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (fallback cure inserted).**

- **Investigation:** Full-document search for "insurance" returned only two hits, neither operative for this rule: p0095 (Obligor insurance premium charges billed to the wireless account) and p0903 (FDIC-insured deposit institution in the account-eligibility definition). Searches for "fidelity bond", "errors and omissions" and "Servicer shall maintain" returned nothing, and Articles III, VI and X contain no coverage covenant.
- **Direction:** The obligation runs against Cellco (Servicer/Marketing Agent/Custodian), the counterparty — it does not burden the Issuer or Depositor.
- **Materiality:** Cellco services the Receivables and holds Obligor account, payment and Receivable File data, so a total absence of E&O/cyber cover is walk-away territory rather than a minor gap.
- **Cure:** New Section 10.14 at the end of Article X (Miscellaneous), drafted at the **fallback** level only — E&O $1,000,000 and cyber/privacy $2,000,000 — with no CGL, workers' compensation, certificate, term-tail or at-own-expense boilerplate volunteered from the preferred position. Redline validated (`ok:true`, minimality passed) before submission.
